description:
## Goal

Install permanent production-API telemetry that measures exact product work across a cold root request and later requests in the same long-lived Compiler2. The report separates population, displacement, recursive publication, retained reuse, producer evaluation, scheduler work, and exact causality so later optimization tickets remove proven work.

This combined replay is based on de058686124776ab6bcf8524d4bb1149aa19be19: PR #110 plus the first twelve approved fz-tfn replays. fz-tfn.25 supplies deterministic one-traversal current-graph search work, fz-tfn.26 supplies typed memoized ordering, and fz-tfn.5 supplies the single surviving root ignition path. fz-tfn.2 still owns reproducible recursive-group membership after its later RuntimeDemand graph cutover; that future graph change does not waive any mismatch on this current graph.

## Combined model

- Product request, producer evaluation, settlement, cache hit, displacement, recursive search, recursive publication, and demand-cone settlement are distinct events.
- Every pull has a checked, nonzero, session-local ProductRequestId. The request and its producer-run evaluation share that identity. Exclusive mutable driver ownership and the producer context API make overlapping or nested ProductDriver pulls impossible; the dead reentered branch/event is deleted. Cache pulls remain requests but do not invent evaluations. Request and global pull-session allocation emit the last nonzero identity once, then fail permanently before telemetry rather than wrap or reuse zero. PullSessionId is nonzero by type, while telemetry-disabled sessions carry None.
- Backend generation has one paired lifecycle gate and one stable typed payload: Started followed by Succeeded with executable/wrapper populations, or Failed. Partial event subscription cannot create a one-sided lifecycle, and error and success use the same event shape.
- Identity and causality use structured ProductKey and fact values. RawProductKey removes only the top-level opaque_type annotation added by the JSONL renderer; all other fields, including same-named state-like and nested fields, remain semantic. Formatted Debug, display, and canonical Ty strings are never logic or semantic authority. Canonical identities exist only at the reporting boundary for exact cross-process comparison.
- Requests within one Compiler2 remain distinct. Cold first production, retained reuse, fresh-session reproduction, equal reproduction, displacement, and cross-request recomputation cannot be conflated.
- Every non-initial evaluation names exact dependency movement or remains visibly unexplained. No exception or invented adjacent cause is allowed.
- Recursive search inspects the exact current dependency graph once; it does not clone the graph per candidate. Traversal work and exact publisher/member identities remain separately observable.
- The harness observes production APIs and introduces no stopwatch threshold, shadow cache, compatibility path, or semantic string key.

## Exact combined baseline

Each row is `(product evaluations, settlements, demanded keys, distinct generations, first productions, cross-request recomputations, unexplained product evaluations, formula evaluations, unexplained formula evaluations)` for cold, unchanged, unreachable edit, reached-leaf edit, and callee replacement respectively.

- fz_f98_range_map_converges: `(2924,2147,2082,2147,2147,0,12,1217,0)`; `(2725,2065,2000,2065,2065,2065,12,0,0)`; `(2725,2065,2000,2065,2065,2065,12,2,0)`; `(2750,2065,2000,2065,2065,2065,12,116,39)`; `(2751,2065,2000,2065,2065,2055,12,179,45)`. Final population `(62 reachable executables, 0 construction wrappers)`.
- enum_predicate_search: `(7461,5430,5046,5269,5223,0,30,1887,0)`; `(7154,5348,4964,5187,5141,5141,30,0,0)`; `(7154,5348,4964,5187,5141,5141,30,2,0)`; `(7218,5348,4964,5187,5141,5141,30,265,90)`; `(7219,5348,4964,5187,5141,5131,30,461,122)`. Final population `(168, 32)`.
- 00420_enum_take_drop_split: `(15841,12309,11806,12147,12053,0,27,3171,0)`; `(15476,12227,11724,12065,11971,11971,27,0,0)`; `(15476,12227,11724,12065,11971,11971,27,2,0)`; `(15608,12227,11724,12065,11971,11971,27,463,156)`; `(15609,12227,11724,12065,11971,11961,27,643,185)`. Final population `(239, 38)`.

The nonzero unexplained product counts are explicit evidence retained by the exact report, not exclusions. Formula unexplained work is zero on all cold, unchanged, and unreachable-edit requests; reached edits retain the exact nonzero values above.

## Public trace budget

The public causal stream retains the same event counts after exact request correlation and balanced backend outcomes: 2,885 events for fz_f98_range_map_converges and 381 for enum_predicate_search. The typed fields produce 1,570,990 and 185,422 JSONL bytes respectively, within permanent 3,000/1.6 MiB and 400/192 KiB caps. These are byte/event ceilings, not timing thresholds.

## Acceptance

- The five scenarios are permanently pinned for all three target fixtures.
- A real ProductDriver path proves eight sequential requests receive distinct identities, its seven waiting/successful producer runs receive exactly matching evaluations, and its cache request receives none. For the moved root request it pins the prior evaluation, exact moved dependency key, settlement trigger kind and position, request/evaluation window, recursive-search dependency/session/position, and request identity; unrelated movement cannot satisfy the record.
- The ProductDriver API and asserted in-progress invariant prove safe producers cannot overlap or recursively invoke pull; no event or compatibility path represents an impossible reentry.
- Request and pull-session exhaustion tests prove the last nonzero identity is unique, zero is never emitted, and no event is emitted after exhaustion.
- Successful and failed backend generation produce balanced, typed lifecycle pairs through the public JSONL subscriber; either lifecycle name enables the pair.
- Cold population, within-request churn, and cross-request recomputation are distinct dimensions; unchanged and irrelevant-edit requests expose fresh-session repopulation directly.
- Recursive search work is attributable to its producer evaluation, stable across processes, and measured separately from publication membership.
- Independent processes produce identical complete canonical causal-work multisets with zero exclusions.
- Documentation explains how to reproduce and read the structured report and distinguishes this exact current graph from the later graph owned by fz-tfn.2.
- Focused telemetry and multi-request tests, all three fixture doors, exact cross-process comparisons, the full library, the single-thread fixture matrix, formatting, check, and strict warning-free clippy pass.

This ticket installs and measures the signal. It does not optimize the compiler.

comments.text: Authorized DAG split: fz-tfn.25 is the prerequisite for stable current-graph search-work telemetry. Exact recursive group membership remains an explicit temporary report dimension until fz-kdt.4 then fz-tfn.2.

fz-tfn.25 found one pre-existing enum_predicate_search causal gap on c521: DeriveExecutableFacts for Enum.any?/2#lambda@4599-4650/2 over main lambda@3054-3113 re-evaluates after settled ActivationAnalyzed/CallSiteSummary movement, changes nothing, then blocks on ActivationAnalyzed. The triggering AnalyzeActivation completion carries the target poststates only in movements, not changed before/after, so replay classifies no cause. Exact command: target/debug/fz2 --log-telemetry TRACE interp fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.fz. The current fz-kdt.46 exact-wait candidate eliminates this gap; its three-target reads+blocked causal regression is green. Recheck and remove any temporary exception when fz-kdt.46 is integrated before closing kdt.5.

Cross-process isolation found identical 2,978 scheduler completion/movement/wake/read records; the first divergence is intra-completion canonical-definition emission order from DeriveCallGraphComponent, which reorders recursive-group settlements and downstream TransportShape/CallableConstruction causality. This belongs to fz-tfn.26 typed completion ordering, not a telemetry exception. Added fz-tfn.26 as a prerequisite; re-run the exact per-key causal gate after its typed comparator lands.

title: Establish cold and incremental product-work causality before optimization
